entries.title: Psalms 46:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song.>> God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 46:2
segments: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

entries.title: Psalms 46:3
segments: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 46:4
segments: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 46:5
segments: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.

entries.title: Psalms 46:6
segments: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.

entries.title: Psalms 46:7
segments: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 46:8
segments: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:9
segments: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.

entries.title: Psalms 46:10
segments: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:11
segments: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
